title: Backups by criticality tier
summary: Each server backed up by how critical it is, spending less on fast copies.
lead: Each server protected according to its value to the business, not all the same.
problem: Every server was backed up with the same policy, paying for fast copies even where they weren't needed.
idea: Classify servers into three tiers by how critical they are and give each tier the protection and cost it deserves, without touching what already works.
change: Less spent on fast copies, a cleanup of orphaned backups and a policy you can explain in one sentence. In progress.
role: I audited the existing backups and policies, classified servers by criticality, designed the three policies and the orphan cleanup, and planned the rollout without migrating what already works.
note: I show the what and the why. Code and client data stay inside Readymind.
